pattern: loose end at settle: write a follow-up
experience: Asked whether a thread can be settled, the agent named a loose end only the user can do (rotate a pasted key) but left it in chat, so it depended on the user's memory.
rule: follow_up_save: Write down a follow-up so it doesn't depend on the user's memory.

pattern: saved follow-up: name it by its link
experience: After saving a follow-up, agents told the user its bare id, like fu-3f55bacd, which says nothing about the work and opens nothing.
rule: follow_up_save: In your reply, name it by its `link` verbatim.
